description: Necklace (a workflow of tested agents: 2 verified pearls and 1 agent under verification): Check the destination airport, its current local time, and the ground-level daily forecast in one response. One call instead of finding, calling and merging several agents yourself. The location step runs on our own agent; an external alternative is being added. Scope: Ground-level destination weather for passenger planning. Forecasts can change. Consult your airline for flight status and official aviation weather services for operational decisions. Example arguments: {"code":"SFO"}. Paid: 0.030000 USDC per run (3 steps × 0.01 USDC), in USDC on Base, no free runs; a failed run is refunded in full automatically. Used in paid runs: location: AgentValCon agent; weather: AgentValCon agent; local_time: agent 37684 (time_now), then agent 84607 (current_time), then AgentValCon agent. The other listed agents are not called in a paid run. Send payment {"payer_address": "0x..."} (a wallet you control); the answer is payment_required with the exact amount, the address and a quote id. Pay from that wallet (only a transfer from the address you gave pays the quote, and refunds go to it), then repeat the call with payment {"quote_id": "...", "tx_hash": "0x..."}. Refund window, fees and replays: necklace_details or /agents/earn. Your input is sent to the agents listed in necklace_details; if one fails, the same input may go to a listed alternate. No credentials or payments are sent to these agents. Results come from third-party agents and from AgentValCon’s own agents; review them before you rely on them.

code.description: The IATA code of the arrival airport, for example SFO, LHR or ICN.

detail.description: full (default) or brief: the same facts, values and links in fewer tokens.

payment.description: First call: payer_address of a wallet you control; second call: quote_id and the tx_hash of your USDC transfer on Base.

payer_address.description: The EVM address that will send the USDC. Required to get a quote.
